checks: Final X continue/halt/revert tactic-only changes preserve statements and normalize identical marker tests before arithmetic; no hypothesis weakened.
Child residual plus event charge is derived from Cert induction; no aggregate gas premise occurs in Cert or final bounds.
CALL-family and CREATE child gas is the actual UInt256.ofNat allowance; Nat.mod_le correctly widens this actual budget to the natural allowance without a no-wrap assumption.
Recursive selected-child dispatch uses the actual opcode, accepted Z stack, gate, fuel and literal child request. Parent outcome is unrestricted.
A child-bearing opcode is not LOG0, so its localCharge is zero. X adds each successful local mark and child/continuation tree counts once; full CALL forwarding cost is not charged twice.

Step errors retain the selected child tree; all-outcome RecursiveEventDebit handles propagated CALL errors, caught Lambda errors and rejecting CREATE word guard. Transparent Theta/Lambda wrappers preserve child charges across rollback and failed installation.
Zero fuel, precompiles and failed creation preimage use empty trees; precompile residual bound is independently established by ReturnedGas.
extracted_bound constructs the actual tree with extract, then obtains gas from gas_bound, Nodup structurally, and uniqueness from deterministic.
extracted_gross_bound follows from residual + extra + 919*count <= gas, nonnegative extra and occurrences_length; natural subtraction is justified by the same budget inequality.

nonblocking_scope_notes.note: For a raw Step request, Cert tree counts only descendants; the local LOG marker is represented by extra. X and execution wrappers include local markers in their trees. Clarify the generic every-marked-occurrence wording if exposed as a raw-step counting API.

On an Except error, residual zero is an accounting convention, not a returned gas field or a proof of actual charged transaction gas. A completed-transaction/refund bridge must justify the economic gross-gas interpretation.
